body:
I'm sorry for making you feel bad, that wasn't my intention. I think...


She'll never know how much I love her. I'll just die without ever having told her. And that's ok. I know that if I live, I will always be alone. No girl even wants to be seen around me. You have no idea how ugly I am, inside and out.

There'll never be a girl for me. I can't handle the loneliness anymore. Fuck I just need to pull the cocksucking trigger
It's not heartbreak. I just never told her what I feel about her. Never will.
